_about: LOADING: the rotating tip line on the loading screen (scripts/ui/loading_screen.gd). Only systems the game has; no new lore. Each tip names the system it teaches.

tips.text: Weaken a wild animal to 30% health, then throw a net to capture it.
Sedatives build torpor. A knocked-out animal can be netted without fighting it down.
Narcoberries and rotten meat make Sedative.
The Food Bag eats front to back: put the food you want eaten first in first.
Raw and cooked meat spoil into Rot. Eat it, dry it or store it before it turns.
Every 5 skill levels past 20, a tree needs a timed research before it climbs further.
Skill points unlock nodes in the Skills sheet; auto nodes are learned free when their level is reached.
Sailing from the Harbour costs Warp Gems, and higher-tier islands need a higher Survival level.
Expedition islands reset when their time runs out. Buildings left there refund half their materials.
Your Tamed Island is yours for good. Expedition islands come and go.
Bring the right tool: bare hands gather slower than an axe, pick or knife on the node it suits.
